MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Christmas Song and The Time-Life Treasury of Christmas feel like natural follow-ups to my recent A Very Special Christmas listening, especially because I am prioritizing holiday music now.",
    "Elvis and Hall & Oates offer familiar older pop and rock hits in collections, matching my repeated interest in greatest-hits albums and compilations."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Bocelli's apparent classical vocal focus and Sade's style feel less connected to the older pop, classic rock, and Christmas recordings I want right now.",
    "When I Fall In Love and Enjoy The Ride do not give me enough information about the artist or recording to connect them confidently to my interests.",
    "Jimmy Buffett and Patsy Cline have some appeal, but that does not make them immediate choices: holiday music takes priority, and country is a less certain fit."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Enjoying greatest-hits collections does not mean I want a collection from every artist; the musical style and familiar songs still matter.",
    "An older recording or a well-known singer is not enough by itself to match my current interest in classic pop, rock, and holiday music."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My latest Christmas album matters more to what I would choose now than a broad resemblance to my older listening.",
    "My interest in vocal recordings such as Cheek to Cheek does not automatically extend to classical vocals or every older vocal style."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in familiar older hits and collections, but only some capture the holiday mood guiding my choices now."
}
